systems.system: المنصة الوطنية للتصريح بالولادات (national birth declaration platform)
systems.country_label: المنصة الوطنية للتصريح بالولادات / المنصة الوطنية لتسجيل الرضع
systems.tiers: first national trial at Mongi Slim hospital, La Marsa: 202 births declared from June 2026 to 27 July 2026, each newborn given a national health identifier linked to the mother's; to be extended gradually to all health institutions; the newborn is still registered at the municipality, where the name can be updated; a direct link to the civil status registers is stated as an aim
named as a national system the birth declaration platform is meant to link to

note: The hospital declares the birth on a health ministry platform and the municipality still registers the newborn, so the system is a notification and gives no fact for civil registration.
